from itertools import product, combinations

# Model: 3 reporters, 2 possible facts. Each reporter's knowledge is the subset
# of facts the press agent told them (premise 1: reporters know only what the agent said).
# "Scoop all others" = knows strictly more than every other reporter (the argument's sense).
facts = (0, 1)
subsets = [frozenset(c) for r in range(3) for c in combinations(facts, r)]
full = frozenset(facts)
n = 3

def no_one_knows_more(K):
    # no reporter knows any more than any other: all knowledge sets equal
    return all(K[i] == K[j] for i in range(n) for j in range(n))

def scoops(K, i):
    return all(K[i] > K[j] for j in range(n) if j != i)

def some_scoop(K):
    return any(scoops(K, i) for i in range(n))

worlds = list(product(subsets, repeat=n))
premise_worlds = []
for K in worlds:
    told_all = all(k == full for k in K)
    p1 = (not told_all) or no_one_knows_more(K)      # told all -> equal knowledge
    p2 = (not no_one_knows_more(K)) or (not some_scoop(K))  # equal -> no scoop
    p3 = not told_all                                # agent did not tell everyone everything
    if p1 and p2 and p3:
        premise_worlds.append(K)

print("worlds satisfying all premises:", len(premise_worlds))

# Conclusion "some reporter can scoop all others" must follow if argument valid.
counter = [K for K in premise_worlds if not some_scoop(K)]
print("premises true, conclusion false (argument invalid):", len(counter) > 0)

# Option B: no reporter knows more than another -- consistent with premises and
# yields a world where the conclusion fails.
B_worlds = [K for K in premise_worlds if no_one_knows_more(K)]
B_counter = [K for K in B_worlds if not some_scoop(K)]
print("B consistent with premises:", len(B_worlds) > 0)
print("example B world (not told all, all equal):",
      [sorted(k) for k in B_worlds[0]] if B_worlds else None)
print("B world falsifies conclusion:", len(B_counter) > 0)

# B is exactly the antecedent of premise 2 holding while premise 1's antecedent is false
# (denying the antecedent flaw). Check this specific pattern exists:
pattern = any((not all(k == full for k in K)) and no_one_knows_more(K) for K in premise_worlds)
print("antecedent of cond.1 false while antecedent of cond.2 true possible:", pattern)

# Option C: a reporter knows more but does not scoop. Under the argument's own sense of
# scooping (knowing more than all others) this is not a fact the argument's gap turns on;
# the gap is that cond.2's antecedent can hold without cond.1's. Check C's scenario
# does not involve the cond.2 antecedent (no_one_knows_more is False there).
C_worlds = [K for K in premise_worlds if not no_one_knows_more(K)
            and any(all(K[i] > K[j] for j in range(n) if j != i) for i in range(n))]
print("C-type worlds have cond.2 antecedent false:",
      all(not no_one_knows_more(K) for K in C_worlds))

if len(B_counter) > 0 and pattern:
    print("Correct choice by computation: B; submitted C does not identify the denial-of-antecedent gap")
    print("CHECK FAIL")
else:
    print("CHECK UNKNOWN")
